sections.title: DAG dispatch ​
sections.description: Directed acyclic graph orchestration powered by @studnicky/dagonizer — every node declares named output ports, scatter handles concurrency, and state flows checkpoint-ready through the run.

sections.title: HTTP machinery ​
sections.description: Three composable classes — RateLimiter, HttpRetryPolicy, and ErrorClassifier — form the HTTP stack, each injected independently.

sections.title: Scrapers ​
sections.description: Pure data accessors for HTML (via cheerio) and MediaWiki (via native fetch) that return typed results without coupling to the DAG graph.

sections.title: Link crawler ​
sections.description: Recursive link crawler controlled by three regexes (domain, delimiter, target) that bound traversal and collect matching URLs.

sections.title: Source map ​
sections.description: Complete index of every source module, its primary exports, and its role in the scrape run.
